purpose: Four rows of W-official-raw-yaml, end to end, before the registered 408-call whitespace flight: prove the -np 3 serving geometry and, above all, that the YAML block-scalar system message really goes on the wire -- the whole point of the cell is a whitespace difference, so the smoke's job is to confirm the bytes, not the accuracy. The rows are the SAME four the calibration and replication smokes used. No smoke number is a task measurement.

W-official-raw-yaml.selection: the SAME four rows the calibration and replication smokes used -- the lexicographically first sample of tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6 of the frozen 400

execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4 for a clean pass; 12 registered because attempt budget is run-cumulative and covers up to two recoveries. The exposure row's own ceiling is 20.
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 16.948 s per pass, 50.844 s across three passes, rounded up to 68 (the same figure the replication smoke registered for these four rows). The exposure row's ceiling is 100.

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, the rendered prompt shape and its system-message hash (which must be the example-config-yaml variant, sha256 eab5138317a3afca..., 16,144 chars), parse rate and throughput
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters the verdict. The calibration's own smoke is the standing precedent: on four rows it saw zero native tool calls and concluded the model was declining the tools interface, which 400 rows corrected to 87 %.

decision.gate: the cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 408-call flight is launched

companion_run.why_separate: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, so a run id cannot span two populations. The two smoke cells therefore run under two run ids, each with its own plan and its own ledger row.
